13: // V7.1.2: iOS 15+ safe replacement for deprecated UIApplication.windows.
14: static NSArray<UIWindow *> *RSAllApplicationWindows(void) {
15:     NSMutableArray<UIWindow *> *result = [NSMutableArray array];
16:     NSSet<UIScene *> *scenes = [UIApplication sharedApplication].connectedScenes;
17:     for (UIScene *scene in scenes) {
18:         if (![scene isKindOfClass:[UIWindowScene class]]) continue;
19:         UIWindowScene *windowScene = (UIWindowScene *)scene;
20:         [result addObjectsFromArray:windowScene.windows];
21:     }
22:     return result;
23: }
